overall_reason: The square icon button answers its press at UI speed, but the plus becomes a close mark in one frame instead of turning the same strokes.

score.reason: T-CONTINUITY fails on the one-frame glyph swap; T-FREQUENCY passes for the 140 ms press.

findings.evidence: svg.tc-glyph declares no transition at capture. In the 1615 ms still the button still shows its pressed, darker background and the glyph is already a finished close mark; at 4009 ms it is a finished plus again.
findings.before: The plus is swapped for a close mark in one frame
findings.after: Rotate the same strokes 45 degrees (about 250 to 450 ms on cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)) so the plus turns into the close mark
findings.why: A plus that turns says the same control now closes what it opened; a swap reads as a different button.

strengths: The press darkens the background on 140 ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), and the button keeps its 36 px box.
not_investigated: Frame-level timing: the passive stills are seven shots over 6 s from a separate load, so durations and curves come from the declarations at 1440, not from frames between stills.
Sweep motion (MOT-002) is not-verified: motion capture was skipped (--no-motion) and there were no click runs; async_state (CMP-001) is not-verified (--no-async).
T-RAPID-TOGGLE and interruptibility: no detector built and no click runs.
Gestures and drags as a person plays them, scroll-driven motion, hover as it plays (only declarations read), and route or page transitions: not captured.
The shared stylesheet's 8 motion_css (MOT-001) hits belong to the sweep and are not repeated here.
